evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies RPC argument handling in src/rpc/net.cpp.
rationale: Fixes a signed integer overflow and silent ban drop when users pass extreme relative ban durations to setban. BanMan calculates ban expiration as GetTime() + bantime using signed 64-bit integers, where extreme values wrapped negative and silently dropped the ban while reporting success; rejecting inputs over UINT32_MAX resolves the undefined behavior and caller misdirection.
